CheckTitle: Amazon SageMaker data quality job definition has inter-container traffic encryption enabled
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Network Security
Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/AWS Foundational Security Best Practices
Description:
Amazon SageMaker data quality job definitions have **inter-container traffic encryption** configured for container-to-container communications.

The check evaluates the `NetworkConfig.EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption` setting on data quality job definitions.
Risk: Without inter-container traffic encryption, communication between ML containers during data quality monitoring jobs is transmitted in plaintext over the network. An attacker with access to the underlying network infrastructure or co-located containers could intercept, eavesdrop on, or manipulate sensitive dataset samples, statistical baselines, drift metrics, and credentials.

Code.NativeIaC:
```yaml
# CloudFormation: SageMaker Data Quality Job Definition with inter-container traffic encryption enabled
Resources:
  SageMakerDataQualityJobDefinition:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::DataQualityJobDefinition
    Properties:
      JobDefinitionName: <job_definition_name>
      RoleArn: <role_arn>
      DataQualityAppSpecification:
        ImageUri: <image_uri>
      DataQualityJobInput:
        EndpointInput:
          EndpointName: <endpoint_name>
          LocalPath: /opt/ml/processing/input
      DataQualityJobOutputConfig:
        MonitoringOutputs:
          - S3Output:
              S3Uri: s3://<bucket>/<prefix>
              LocalPath: /opt/ml/processing/output
      JobResources:
        ClusterConfig:
          InstanceCount: 1
          InstanceType: ml.m5.large
          VolumeSizeInGB: 20
      NetworkConfig:
        EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption: true  # CRITICAL: Encrypts network traffic between containers
```
Code.Other:
1. In the AWS console, navigate to Amazon SageMaker > Model monitor > Job definitions
2. When creating a data quality job definition, expand the Network settings section
3. Enable the 'Enable inter-container traffic encryption' option
4. Recreate any existing unencrypted job definitions with this setting enabled, as job definitions cannot be modified in-place

Recommendation.Text: Enable inter-container traffic encryption on all SageMaker data quality job definitions by configuring `NetworkConfig.EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption` to `true`. Recreate existing unencrypted job definitions with encryption enabled, and enforce network isolation and least privilege on execution roles.
